craft_text:
### Service and submission psychology

> Each mundane task became part of the chosen ritual: food prepared, coffee
> poured, attention held. Her private refrain reduced itself to three beats:
> useful, used, wanted.

Use ordinary objects and actions to reveal why an adult character finds a power
dynamic meaningful. Preserve the difference between chosen service, anxious
people-pleasing, and coerced compliance.
